arguments.command:
python -c "
import argparse
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
s = parser.add_subparsers(dest='which')
# s.required = True
parser_bump = s.add_parser('bump')
parser_bump.set_defaults(which='bump')
sb = parser_bump.add_subparsers(dest='bump', title='Bump commands')
# sb.required = True
for pname in ['major','minor','patch']:
    p = sb.add_parser(pname)
    p.add_argument('version')
args = parser.parse_args(['bump'])
print('args:', args)
print('has which:', hasattr(args, 'which'))
print('has bump:', hasattr(args, 'bump'))
print('has version:', hasattr(args, 'version'))
"
